about.metaDescription: Why PandaDev exists and how it teaches programming from your first line of code to senior level.
about.title: Learning to code should feel like <gradient>play</gradient>
about.description: PandaDev is a free, open-source place to learn programming, from your very first line of code to senior engineering.

why.title: Why PandaDev?
why.body: Most tutorials either stop at the basics or assume you already know everything. PandaDev gives every language one clear path through four levels, Beginner → Junior → Middle → Senior, so you always know what to learn next and why it matters.

how.title: How it works
how.lessons: Short lessons explain one idea at a time, with examples that show exactly what the code prints.
how.browser: Code in your browser. Every exercise has an editor, a Run button and automatic checks. There's nothing to install.
how.motivation: Quizzes, XP and streaks keep you motivated and show how far you've come.
how.projects: Projects at the end of each module and level turn what you learned into something you can show.

tested.title: Every lesson is tested
tested.body: Every code example and every exercise solution in PandaDev is run automatically before it's published, so the output you see in a lesson is the output you'll really get.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: PandaDev is built in the open with Next.js, React and TypeScript. You can read the code, suggest lessons or report a mistake <github>on GitHub</github>.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Found a bug or have an idea? <issue>Open an issue on GitHub</issue>. Ready to start? <link>Pick a language</link>.

pricing.metaDescription: PandaDev is free during the beta: every lesson, exercise and feature.
pricing.title: Free while we're in <gradient>beta</gradient>
pricing.description: No plans to compare and no credit card. Just start learning.
pricing.summary: Everything PandaDev offers today, for everyone.

included.editor: In-browser code editor with automatic checks
included.gamification: Quizzes, XP, levels, streaks and achievements
included.playground: The playground, as much as you like

free.a: Yes. During the beta everything is free, with no credit card and no trial that runs out.

account.a: No. You can read every lesson and run every exercise without one. Sign in to save your progress, XP and streaks.

start.q: What do I need to start?
start.a: Just a browser. Everything, including running your code, happens right on the page.

privacy.metaDescription: What data PandaDev collects, why, and how to delete it.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: In short: we collect as little as we can, never sell it, and you can delete everything at any time.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.account: Account details, only if you sign in: your name, email address and profile picture from GitHub or Google, plus which provider you used. We never see your GitHub or Google password.
collect.progress: Learning progress: lessons you completed, XP you earned (and for what), and achievements you unlocked.
collect.signIn: Basic sign-in records: when you signed in, your IP address and browser type, kept with your session for security.

device.title: What stays on your device
device.code: Your code. Code you write in exercises and the playground runs in your own browser and is saved there (local storage). It is not sent to us.
device.timeZone: Your time zone is stored in a small cookie so your daily streak follows your own midnight.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only the cookies the site needs to work: sign-in cookies while you sign in and stay signed in, and the time zone cookie. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.vercel: We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page views. It doesn't use cookies and doesn't identify you; we only see totals such as how many people visited a lesson. Vercel Speed Insights measures how fast pages load (for example, time until the main content appears), also without cookies, so we can keep the site quick.
analytics.sentry: If the site crashes, an error report (what went wrong, on which page, and your browser type) goes to Sentry so we can fix it. Reports don't include your name, email, cookies or the code you write.

processors.title: Who processes the data
processors.neon: Neon stores the database with accounts and progress.
processors.sentry: Sentry receives error reports when something breaks.
processors.signIn: GitHub and Google handle sign-in if you choose them.
processors.jsdelivr: jsDelivr serves Pyodide, which runs Python in your browser, and the TypeScript compiler, which checks TypeScript code. Your browser downloads them from their network the first time you run Python or TypeScript code; your code itself never leaves your device.
processors.noSale: We never sell your data or share it for advertising.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body: Go to your profile and choose Delete account. This permanently removes your account, sessions, progress, XP and achievements straight away. To remove saved code, clear this site's data in your browser.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: Ask anything about your data by <issue>opening an issue on GitHub</issue>.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The simple rules for using PandaDev.

using.title: Using PandaDev
using.body: PandaDev is a free learning website. You can read lessons, run code and practise without an account. By using the site you agree to these terms and our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

account.title: Your account
account.signIn: You sign in with GitHub or Google and are responsible for keeping that account secure.
account.delete: You can delete your PandaDev account at any time from your <link>profile</link>.
account.suspend: We may suspend accounts that abuse the service, for example by trying to cheat XP or attack the site.

code.title: Your code
code.body: Code you write in exercises and the playground is yours. It runs in your own browser, so please don't run code you don't trust.

content.title: Our content
content.body: Lessons, exercises and the PandaDev design are made by PandaDev. You are welcome to use what you learn anywhere, but please don't copy whole lessons to publish elsewhere. The website's source code is available on <github>GitHub</github>.

warranty.title: No guarantees
warranty.body: We work hard to keep lessons accurate and the site running, but PandaDev is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for any loss arising from using the site.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms as PandaDev grows. The date at the top shows when they last changed.
